title: Audit Evidence Self-Service Portal: Milestone Orchestration and Risk-Tagged Proof Buckets
creator: Liam O'Neill
description: Build an audit evidence self-service portal that lets customers collect, validate, and export proof artifacts for SOC2/ISO audits without filing tickets. Portal features include risk-tagged proof buckets, automated evidence expiry/refresh scheduling, audit-pack generation (CSV+PDF), and a customer-facing timeline showing milestone completion. This ticket tracks milestone orchestration, cross-team dependencies (SSO/SAML, audit log retention, KMS), and the gated rollout plan to enterprise customers.
milestones: M1 - Scoping & schema (2026-02-20 to 2026-03-05): field-level evidence schema, S3 bucket patterns, retention policy mappings, RBAC roles for proof access.
M2 - Service & API (2026-03-06 to 2026-03-22): internal API for registering evidence, risk-tagging endpoint, evidence TTL/refresh scheduler, admin audit endpoints.
M3 - Portal UI & exports (2026-03-23 to 2026-04-05): customer portal screens, proof bucket views, 'Generate Audit Pack' export, contributor activity timeline.
M4 - Integrations & hardening (2026-04-06 to 2026-04-12): SSO/SAML access checks, audit-log crosswalk, KMS-key scoping, performance tuning for exports.
M5 - Pilot & signoff (2026-04-13 to 2026-04-15): pilot with 2 enterprise customers, checklist signoff (security, legal, customer success), and readiness gating for general availability.
Post-GA - Observability & retention automation (2026-04-16+): telemetry dashboards for proof usage, auto-remediation playbooks, retention audit alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can create and tag proof buckets that map to SOC2 control families (CC6, CC7) and ISO clauses.
Portal exports a downloadable Audit Pack containing evidence metadata, file links, and an automated evidence manifest (CSV + signed JSON) within < 90s for packages up to 5GB.
Evidence TTL/refresh scheduler triggers automated expiry notifications and shows next-expected refresh date to customers.
RBAC enforced: only tenant admins + scoped read-only reviewers can access export endpoints; SSO/SAML assertion must be honored for portal sessions.
Security review completed and checklist items remediated (cryptographic safeguards, KMS usage, temp credentials revoked).
rollout_plan: Staged rollouts: internal beta -> partner pilot (2 customers) -> invite-only GA for enterprise customers -> open GA. Each stage includes a 48h soak window and rollback plan. Customer success will run onboarding playbooks with the pilot customers and collect sample audit evidence for SOC2 mock audit. Post-pilot, create a public docs page and a console walkthrough video.
risks_mitigation: Risk: Sensitive evidence stored incorrectly. Mitigation: enforce server-side encryption with customer-managed KMS keys; storage scanners flag misconfigured buckets.
Risk: Long export times for large evidence sets. Mitigation: stream exports with chunked gzipped payloads and background job with progress tokens; enforce export size quota per tenant.

Risk: Mis-tagged evidence leading to audit gaps. Mitigation: pre-built tag templates per compliance framework and inline validation rules; allow auditors to request missing artifacts with one-click collection tasks.
Risk: Access-control bypass in portal. Mitigation: SSO assertion revalidation on export, additional signed attestation step for privileged downloads.
Risk: Dependencies delayed (SSO/SAML integration). Mitigation: fallbacks in portal to manual mapping flows and a clearly displayed dependency status to customers.
stakeholders: Eng: Backend - Rajesh Patel, Frontend - Eva Morales, Infra - Marcus Li
metrics_kpis: Time to generate audit pack (median) < 60s for <=1GB
Portal adoption: % of enterprise customers with >=1 proof bucket within 30 days of GA >= 30%
Evidence freshness: % of proof artifacts with TTL renewed before expiry >= 95%
Support ticket volume reduction: 40% fewer compliance evidence requests filed to support compared to baseline
Security incidents related to proof storage: 0 post-GA
decisions: Use tenant-scoped customer-managed KMS keys for evidence-at-rest (decided 2026-02-25).
Implement proof-bucket TTL with soft-delete + retention extension APIs rather than immediate hard-deletes to support auditor retrieval (decided 2026-02-28).
Export format will be CSV + signed JSON manifest and optional obfuscated file bundle for sensitive artifacts (decided 2026-03-03).
